Guess the PSA 10 price of all 3 cheap Yu-Gi-Oh! cards, then swipe for the answers. How close were you? 👇

Answers (no peeking 🙈):
#1 Dark Magician Girl RA03-EN123 (Quarter Century Bonanza): $11.08 raw → $265 PSA 10 (24×)
#2 Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon RA02-EN021 (25th Anniversary Rarity Collection II): $13.77 raw → $204 PSA 10 (15×)
#3 Dark Magician Girl RA04-EN107 (Quarter Century Stampede): $13.35 raw → $170 PSA 10 (13×)

PSA 10 = median eBay sold price over the last 60 days. Raw = TCGplayer market price. Not every card grades a 10, so check centering first (free centering tool at market.driveyourstyle.net).
